name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 20 – Am 27
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 20a. Expresses grave concern regarding the weaponisation of fundamental rights to curtail the freedom of expression and warns against the EU constructing a centralised censorship apparatus under the guise of combating ‘disinformation’ and ‘hate speech’;
